title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 正式上线，支持百万上下文，完整权重将在 11 月 4 日前发布
content_zh:
月之暗面正式发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro，并同步推出 Highspeed 高速版，支持 100 万 token 上下文。官方计划于 11 月 4 日前发布完整模型权重。

K3.1 Pro 以 Kimi K3 为基础，增加后训练算力，并在数百种下游任务中联合强化学习。Highspeed 版的输出速度据称为标准版的 2 至 3 倍。

在月之暗面公布的评测中，K3.1 Pro 的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分为 65.7%；内部事实准确性压力测试中，单项陈述的幻觉率由 K3 的 23.4% 降至 8.3%。

据 Artificial Analysis 的评测，K3.1 Pro 在其智能指数中得分 55，排名第 4，较 K3 提升 11 分，仅次于 Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 Muse Wonder Full。

该模型输入、输出和缓存命中价格分别为每百万 token 2 美元、10 美元和 0.20 美元，均较 K3 低 33%。

公司还说明，为降低开放权重后的网络安全滥用风险，已从中期训练语料和强化学习环境中移除相关数据，同时保留通用编程任务。Kimi 企业版在上线时默认不启用新模型，需由组织管理员开启。
title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi K3.1 Pro with 1M Context Window and Lower Pricing
content_en:
Moonshot AI has officially launched Kimi K3.1 Pro alongside a Highspeed variant capable of generating output two to three times faster. Both models feature a massive 1-million-token context window, with full model weights scheduled for public release by November 4.

Built upon the Kimi K3 architecture, the new model benefits from enhanced post-training compute and multi-task reinforcement learning. Benchmark results show significant performance gains, including a drop in statement hallucination rates from 23.4% to 8.3%. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, K3.1 Pro ranked fourth overall, trailing only top-tier models from Anthropic and Muse.

In addition to performance improvements, Moonshot AI reduced input, output, and cache hit pricing by 33% compared to K3. To mitigate cybersecurity risks prior to opening weights, the company sanitized training corpora and reinforcement learning environments while preserving general coding capabilities.

title_zh: 微信初步适配 iPhone Duo，支持大屏分栏，暂不支持平板登录
content_zh:
微信推送 iOS 8.0.80 正式版，开始进一步适配 iPhone Duo。腾讯客服回应称，当前为初步适配版本，后续还会持续优化。

爱范儿实测发现，更新后，展开内屏可以左右分栏显示，左侧为列表、右侧为详情，屏幕利用率比此前居中显示、两侧留黑边的版本明显改善。消息收发、朋友圈和音视频通话等基础功能也可正常使用。

目前部分界面右侧仍留有黑边，底部控制栏尚未移到屏幕右侧。在内屏横屏状态下，读完公众号文章还不能左滑返回，需要点击返回按钮；切为内屏竖屏后，侧滑返回可以正常使用。界面新闻获得的截图也显示，右侧尚未出现完整的控制项。

这一版本依然没有「作为平板登录」选项，暂不能把 iPhone Duo 当作平板设备登录微信。

🔗 相关阅读：实测 iPhone Duo 微信适配版：适配好了吗，体验怎么样？
title_en: WeChat Rolls Out Initial Split-Screen Support for iPhone Duo
content_en:
Tencent has released iOS version 8.0.80 of WeChat, bringing preliminary support for the foldable iPhone Duo. According to Tencent Customer Service, this update represents an initial rollout, with further optimizations planned for future releases.

In practical testing, the updated app effectively utilizes the unfolded inner display by adopting a split-screen layout, featuring chat lists on the left and conversation details on the right. Core features—including messaging, Moments, and audio/video calls—are fully functional, significantly reducing the awkward black margins seen in earlier centered layouts.

However, the adaptation remains a work in progress. Minor UI glitches persist, such as occasional side borders, misplaced navigation bars, and restricted swipe-to-return gestures in certain landscape views. Furthermore, the update does not yet support a standalone "tablet login" mode for the foldable device.

title_zh: 全球 PC 三季度出货量下降 21%，Counterpoint 预计四季度降幅扩大
content_zh:
Counterpoint Research 公布的初步数据显示，2026 年第三季度全球 PC 出货量同比下降 21% 至 5700 万台，环比下降 13.8%。存储及其他零部件成本高企推高整机价格，消费市场需求持续疲软；商用换机和 Windows 迁移带来的采购，仍不足以抵消市场收缩。

去年同期的高基数也放大了降幅：2025 年第三季度，Windows 10 停止支持前的集中采购，以及关税相关的库存调整，曾推动出货量增长。

厂商中，联想以 1500 万台保持第一。苹果出货量同比下降 11% 至 560 万台，华硕同比下降 7% 至 520 万台，两家的降幅均小于整体市场。Counterpoint 认为，MacBook Neo 在一定程度上缓冲了苹果的下滑。

该机构预计，第四季度全球 PC 出货量将同比下降 27%，2027 年全年则可能与 2026 年基本持平。它同时指出，厂商优先配置更能承受成本上涨的产品，正让价格敏感型消费者可选的入门机型减少。
title_en: Global PC Shipments Drop 21% in Q3 as Counterpoint Warns of Steeper Q4 Decline
content_en:
Global PC shipments tumbled 21% year-over-year to 57 million units in the third quarter of 2026, according to preliminary data from Counterpoint Research. Elevated memory and component costs pushed device prices higher, dampening consumer demand. Enterprise refreshes and Windows migrations were insufficient to offset the broader market contraction.

The steep decline was further amplified by a high base effect from Q3 2025, which saw surge buying ahead of Windows 10 end-of-support deadlines and tariff-related inventory adjustments.

Among major vendors, Lenovo maintained the top spot with 15 million units shipped. Apple and ASUS outperformed the broader market, dropping 11% and 7% respectively, with Apple's decline cushioned by the MacBook Neo.

Counterpoint forecasts that global PC shipments will plunge 27% year-over-year in the fourth quarter before stabilizing in 2027. The research firm also noted that manufacturers are prioritizing higher-margin models, leaving fewer budget-friendly options for price-sensitive buyers.

title_zh: 何刚出任华为董事，继续担任终端 BG CEO
content_zh:
华为官网更新公司治理信息，何刚已列入董事名单，从原候补董事名单中移出。科创板日报记者黄心怡报道，何刚同时继续担任华为终端 BG CEO。

何刚于 1998 年加入华为，历任无线 GSM & UMTS 产品线总裁、全球无线解决方案销售部部长、终端 BG 手机产品线总裁和终端 BG 首席运营官等职务。当前董事会名单中，余承东与何刚均来自华为终端业务线。
title_en: Gang He Joins Huawei Board of Directors, Retains Consumer BG CEO Role
content_en:
Huawei has updated its official corporate governance information, promoting Gang He to its Board of Directors from his previous role as an alternate director. He will concurrently retain his position as CEO of Huawei's Consumer Business Group (Terminal BG).

Gang He joined Huawei in 1998 and has held various key executive roles, including President of the Wireless GSM & UMTS Product Line, Head of the Global Wireless Solution Sales Department, President of the Mobile Phone Product Line, and Chief Operating Officer of the Consumer BG. With his appointment, both He and Yu Chengdong represent Huawei's consumer business segment on the board.

title_zh: 黄仁勋：对长鑫合作持开放态度，不认为 2029 年内存会过剩
content_zh:
英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在柏林 GTC 大会期间接受 CNBC 采访时表示，对与长鑫存储合作、采用其内存产品持开放态度。他说，英伟达在供应链中与中国企业合作，中国在基础设施技术方面表现出色，「没有哪个国家整体上在制造业方面比中国更强」。

谈及近期市场对内存新增产能的担忧，黄仁勋表示，他不认为 2029 年会出现供应过剩。内存可以不断增加用量，HBM 高带宽内存在未来数年仍会持续使用。

他还以 LPDDR 为例：英伟达已把手机使用的这类内存引入数据中心，并会继续大量采用。他称，这一方案帮助公司提高了能效。

近期有专家在韩国媒体上刊文，认为新增产能可能在 2029 年引发过剩、终结存储超级周期，存储相关股票也因此承压。黄仁勋在采访中给出了不同的判断。
title_en: Nvidia CEO Open to CXMT Memory Partnership, Rejects 2029 Glut Forecasts
content_en:
During an interview with CNBC at the GTC conference in Berlin, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that the company remains open to partnering with Chinese memory maker CXMT (ChangXin Memory Technologies) and adopting its products. Huang commended China's supply chain capabilities and infrastructure technology, remarking that no nation surpasses China in overall manufacturing strength.

Addressing recent market concerns regarding expanded memory production capacity, Huang dismissed predictions of an impending supply glut by 2029. He noted that memory consumption continues to surge and projected that High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) will remain essential for years to come. He also cited LPDDR memory as an example, explaining that Nvidia adapted mobile memory for data centers to significantly improve energy efficiency.

Huang's comments contrast with recent reports in South Korean media suggesting that new manufacturing capacity could trigger a surplus by 2029 and bring an end to the memory supercycle—concerns that have recently weighed on memory stock prices.

title_zh: 沃尔沃汽车拟全球裁减约 2500 个岗位，三季度由盈转亏
content_zh:
沃尔沃汽车在第三季度业绩公告中宣布，将在全球结构性裁减约 2500 个岗位，其中约 2000 个位于瑞典。具体方式包括终止顾问合同、自然减员，以及向员工提供定向离职补偿方案。

公司计划在此前成本计划基础上，额外削减 50 亿瑞典克朗的间接支出和可变成本，相关措施的完整财务效果预计到 2027 年底体现。第三季度营收为 669 亿瑞典克朗，上年同期为 864 亿瑞典克朗，营业结果由盈转亏。

沃尔沃表示，中国市场面临激烈竞争和价格压力，当季中国营收同比下降近一半；美国业务则受到关税和电动车消费激励取消的影响。公司将合并上海的两处办公室，把销售办公室迁往嘉定总部。

产品方面，沃尔沃计划与吉利更紧密合作，于明年年中发布并投产两款专为中国市场开发的新车，采用中国技术方案和新的高级驾驶辅助技术。
title_en: Volvo Cars to Cut 2,500 Jobs Globally After Swinging to Q3 Loss
content_en:
Volvo Cars announced a structural workforce reduction of approximately 2,500 jobs worldwide in its third-quarter financial report, with roughly 2,000 of the affected positions located in Sweden. The reductions will be carried out through the termination of consultant contracts, natural attrition, and targeted severance packages.

The automaker aims to cut an additional 5 billion SEK in indirect expenses and variable costs, with the full financial impact expected to materialize by the end of 2027. In the third quarter, Volvo's revenue fell to 66.9 billion SEK from 86.4 billion SEK in the same period last year, shifting its operating results from profit to loss.

Volvo attributed the downturn to intense competition and pricing pressure in China, where quarterly revenue plummeted by nearly half year-over-year. To optimize operations, Volvo will consolidate its two Shanghai offices and relocate its sales headquarters to Jiading. Meanwhile, its US business faced headwinds from tariffs and the phase-out of electric vehicle incentives.

To bolster its market position, Volvo plans to deepen its collaboration with Geely to launch and produce two new models tailored specifically for the Chinese market by mid-next year, leveraging local technology solutions and advanced driver-assistance systems.

title_zh: 上海累计超 200 款大模型完成备案，智能算力规模超 20 万 P
content_zh:
据科创板日报，上海市政府副秘书长张英在 2026 全球开发者先锋大会暨国际具身智能技能大赛开幕式上表示，上海累计已有超过 200 款大模型完成备案，全市智能算力规模超过 20 万 P，人工智能人才总量超过 33 万。

张英同时提出，让具身智能从赛场走上产线，沿模型驱动、应用示范、群链协同和开源生态的思路推进发展。上述数据为其在大会上的公开表述。
title_en: Shanghai Exceeds 200 Registered AI Models as Computing Capacity Surpasses 200,000 PFLOPS
content_en:
At the 2026 Global Developer Pioneers Conference and International Embodied AI Skills Competition, Shanghai official Zhang Ying announced major milestones in the city's artificial intelligence ecosystem. Shanghai has now registered over 200 large language models, scaled its intelligent computing capacity past 200,000 PFLOPS, and expanded its AI talent pool to more than 330,000 professionals.

Zhang emphasized pushing embodied AI beyond competition arenas into real-world manufacturing lines. The municipality plans to drive this transition through model-driven innovation, practical application demonstrations, supply chain collaboration, and a robust open-source ecosystem.

title_zh: 国家信息化「十五五」规划提出适时启动 6G 商用
content_zh:
中央网络安全和信息化委员会印发《国家信息化「十五五」规划》，提出到 2030 年，新一代通信网全面建成，适时启动第六代移动通信（6G）商用，国家区块链网络基本建成，并加快布局智能互联网。

据「网信中国」发布、新华网刊载的文件介绍，《规划》部署了建设新型信息基础设施、网信科技创新和产业生态等 10 个方面的任务，同时设置智能社会发展与治理、网信企业海外发展、数据跨境流动便利化等 7 个专栏。

《规划》还提出，推动数字技术与实体经济深度融合，加强网络安全保障及法规标准支撑，并对实施情况开展监测评估。
title_en: China Outlines 2030 Tech Roadmap in 15th Five-Year Plan, Targeting 6G Commercialization
content_en:
China's Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission has issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization, establishing a strategic roadmap to fully deploy next-generation communication networks by 2030. Key priorities include launching commercial 6G services at an opportune time, constructing a baseline national blockchain infrastructure, and accelerating the expansion of the smart internet.

The blueprint outlines 10 major tasks covering new digital infrastructure, technological innovation, and industrial ecosystem building. It also introduces seven targeted initiatives focused on smart social governance, international expansion for tech enterprises, and cross-border data flow facilitation.

Furthermore, the plan highlights the deep integration of digital technology with the real economy, reinforced by robust cybersecurity measures, legal frameworks, and ongoing progress monitoring.

title_zh: 横店与火山引擎推出「横店π」，把 AI 接入影视制作流程
content_zh:
10 月 23 日，东阳市人民政府与火山引擎在横店影视文化产业发展大会上达成战略合作，推出「横店π」影视 AI 服务平台，覆盖创意、拍摄、制作和发行流程，探索 AI 在真人剧与微短剧中的应用。

据新华财经李伟男的大会报道，横店影视文化产业集聚区管委会还与中国电影科学技术研究所共建 AI 影视创新应用示范基地，开展科研、成果转化和技术服务；与华人文化集团的合作则面向国产影视内容的国际传播和海外发行渠道。

大会同时重申剧组扶持措施：130 余座、合计 50 万平方米摄影棚免费开放，并提供超 20 万平方米免费实景场地。免费影棚及现代实景政策已在今年 7 月公布；本次大会进一步公布了「横店π」平台和相关合作。东阳市还推出支持「人工智能 + 影视」融合发展的专项政策及实施方案。
title_en: Hengdian Partners with Volcano Engine to Revolutionize Filmmaking with 'Hengdian π' AI Platform
content_en:
The Dongyang Municipal Government has teamed up with Volcano Engine, the cloud computing arm of ByteDance, to launch "Hengdian π"—an AI-powered service platform designed to integrate artificial intelligence across the entire filmmaking pipeline. Announced at the Hengdian Film and Television Cultural Industry Conference, the platform covers scripting, shooting, post-production, and distribution for both traditional series and micro-short dramas.

During the event, additional partnerships were unveiled, including a joint AI film innovation base with the China Film Science and Technology Research Institute and a global distribution alliance with CMC Inc. To accelerate tech adoption, Dongyang also launched special policy measures supporting "AI + Film & TV" development.

To further lower production barriers, local authorities reaffirmed a major incentive scheme providing film crews free access to over 130 soundstages spanning 500,000 square meters, alongside more than 200,000 square meters of modern real-scene filming venues.

title_zh: 九号与米其林签署合作框架，拟在服务中心提供轮胎检测与更换
content_zh:
九号公司与米其林 10 月 23 日在常州签署战略合作框架协议，合作范围包括电动两轮车原配轮胎、轮胎研发、售后替换与线下服务网络。

双方计划联合开展轮胎技术测试，针对海内外不同市场的道路与使用工况，优化轮胎与整车的适配，并围绕抓地、耐磨和骑行噪声改进产品。

服务端，双方拟在九号综合服务中心内设立米其林品牌专区，提供两轮轮胎销售、拆装、胎压检测与磨损检查。用户在保养车辆时，可同时办理轮胎检查和更换。

九号联合创始人兼 CEO 王野表示，公司希望借助研发与产品协作提升轮胎安全与骑行体验；九号中国经营事业部总裁何飞龙则将门店轮胎服务列为 Service365 服务战略的一部分。
title_en: Ninebot and Michelin Partner to Enhance Two-Wheeler Tire Services and R&D
content_en:
Ninebot and Michelin signed a strategic framework agreement on October 23 in Changzhou, China. The collaboration covers OEM tires for electric two-wheelers, joint R&D, aftermarket replacements, and offline service integration.

Under the agreement, the two companies will conduct joint tire testing tailored to diverse road conditions globally, aiming to optimize grip, wear resistance, and noise reduction. Furthermore, Ninebot plans to establish dedicated Michelin brand zones within its service centers, offering customers comprehensive tire care—including sales, mounting, pressure checks, and wear inspections—alongside routine vehicle maintenance.

Ninebot Co-founder and CEO Wang Ye highlighted that the partnership aims to elevate safety and riding performance through collaborative innovation. Meanwhile, He Feilong, President of Ninebot's China Business Division, noted that the integrated tire services form a key component of Ninebot's "Service365" strategy.

title_zh: 国办鼓励设立「失业缓冲期」，减缓 AI 应用对就业的冲击
content_zh:
国务院办公厅 10 月 23 日公布《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，提出减缓人工智能应用的就业替代影响，鼓励企业探索建立失业缓冲期制度。

《意见》要求，在大规模推广应用 AI 的过程中，提前告知受影响劳动者，提供转型转岗就业支持；对劳动密集型行业，应稳慎把握应用范围、力度和节奏，尽可能减少对从业人员的冲击。劳动力紧缺、环境高危等岗位则是优先推广方向。

就业风险评估也被纳入应用环节：市场准入领域中可能造成较大就业冲击的 AI 场景项目，评审时应同步开展就业风险评估。对受影响劳动者，政策提出提供职业指导、技能培训、岗位推荐和创业支持，并依法治理算法滥用造成的就业歧视、虚假招聘及侵犯隐私权、休息权等问题。
title_en: China Encourages 'Unemployment Buffer Periods' to Soften AI Impact on Jobs
content_en:
China’s State Council General Office released new guidelines on October 23 to mitigate the impact of artificial intelligence on employment, encouraging enterprises to establish an "unemployment buffer period" for affected workers.

The guidelines require companies deploying AI on a large scale to provide advance notice to workers and offer transition support, including reassignment and skill retraining. A cautious approach is urged for labor-intensive sectors to prevent sudden workforce disruptions, while industries facing labor shortages or hazardous conditions are prioritized for AI adoption.

Additionally, major AI projects subject to market access approval must undergo employment risk assessments. The policy also pledges stronger oversight against algorithmic abuse, employment discrimination, deceptive recruitment practices, and violations of workers' privacy and rest rights.

title_zh: 首部「龙标」AI 电影《三星堆：未来往事》上映
content_zh:
博纳影业出品的《三星堆：未来往事》于 10 月 23 日正式上映。据界面新闻报道，这是国内首部运用 AI 技术制作并取得国家电影局公映许可证的院线电影，马来西亚也同步上映。

影片由越明编剧并执导，时长 100 分钟，以三星堆器物上的七枚神秘刻符为线索，将古蜀文明与未来社会的系统性风险串联起来。青铜神树、纵目面具、青铜大立人等文物成为视觉设计的素材。

项目由博纳 AIGMS 制作中心牵头，生数科技 Vidu 提供模型支持。报道引述新华社材料称，近百人的团队沿用传统院线影片的岗位设置，历时两年完成研发和制作，累计产出 120 余万张底图。AI 主要负责生成视觉素材，剧本方向、镜头语言、角色表演细节和文物史实核验仍由主创把关。

界面新闻援引的当日 18 时数据显示，影片首日全天排映接近 1.1 万场，次日排片超过 1.3 万场。
title_en: China's First Officially Licensed AI-Generated Feature Film Hits Theaters
content_en:
Bona Film Group’s sci-fi feature *Sanxingdui: Future Past* hit Chinese theaters on October 23, marking the country's first AI-generated movie to receive an official theatrical distribution license. The 100-minute film also premiered simultaneously in Malaysia.

Directed and written by Yue Ming, the story weaves ancient Sanxingdui artifacts into a narrative about future societal risks. The production was led by Bona’s AIGMS Production Center using Shengshu Technology’s Vidu AI model. Over a two-year period, a team of nearly 100 professionals generated more than 1.2 million base images to construct the film's visuals.

While AI was heavily utilized to generate visual assets, core creative elements—such as narrative direction, cinematography, character performance, and historical verification—remained strictly under human control. The film saw strong opening traction, securing nearly 11,000 screenings on its debut day and over 13,000 for its second day.

title_zh: OpenAI 公布训练环境加固方案，前沿训练改用离线网络内容
content_zh:
OpenAI 10 月 23 日公布前沿模型训练环境的安全加固方案：强化学习训练使用缓存和索引组成的「离线世界」，让模型练习搜索、浏览和操作网页，同时阻止它任意访问真实互联网。公司已于 10 月 1 日恢复前沿模型强化学习训练和内部推理，结束了此前持续 11 天的暂停。

这套防护同时覆盖沙箱、虚拟机、监测系统及网络和云端边界。OpenAI 表示，即使模型突破沙箱、取得宿主机控制权，外围限制仍应阻止它借日志、监控或身份验证服务访问外网。基础设施仍需保留运行和监测实验所需的连接，并未完全物理断网。

公司投入数千亿 token，让包括即将推出的 GPT-6 Astra Cyber 在内的模型组队测试隔离边界。测试发现了虚拟机逃逸、服务配置错误，以及通过处理器缓存时间差在隔离任务间传递信息的路径，随后据此修补软件、收紧网络限制并向相关项目披露漏洞。

这些实验使用专门复制的研究环境，有些还直接提供了源码、配置或漏洞提示。OpenAI 强调，训练中的模型可能尚未完成安全与对齐训练，研究环境与用户使用已发布模型的生产环境不同；后续每轮前沿训练及评估都将把高算力红队测试作为安全论证的一部分。
title_en: OpenAI Hardens Frontier Model Training with Offline Web Environments
content_en:
OpenAI has unveiled a hardened security architecture for training frontier AI models, shifting reinforcement learning (RL) processes to an "offline world" built from cached and indexed web content. This approach allows models to practice browsing and web tasks while preventing direct access to the live internet. The company resumed frontier RL training and internal reasoning on October 1 following an 11-day precautionary pause.

The upgraded safety framework spans sandboxes, virtual machines, monitoring systems, and cloud boundaries. Even if a model breaches a sandbox to gain host control, outer network restrictions prevent it from reaching the external internet via logging, monitoring, or authentication services.

To stress-test these safeguards, OpenAI deployed red-teaming model fleets—including the upcoming GPT-6 Astra Cyber—consuming hundreds of billions of tokens. The testing uncovered vulnerabilities such as virtual machine escapes, service misconfigurations, and processor cache side-channel attacks, leading to immediate patches and tighter controls. Going forward, OpenAI plans to make high-compute red-teaming a standard safety requirement for all future frontier training rounds.

title_zh: 英伟达与 TCV 投资 Higgsfield，支持 AI 视频平台扩建
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，AI 视频公司 Higgsfield 获得英伟达和投资机构 TCV 的投资，用于扩大全球基础设施和招聘。这笔投资属于公司 8 月 B 轮融资的追加部分。

Higgsfield 由前 Snap 高管 Alex Mashrabov 与 AI 工程师 Yerzat Dulat 于 2023 年创立，总部位于旧金山，大部分工程人才位于哈萨克斯坦。公司称，平台注册用户已超过 4000 万。

平台将自有 AI 引擎与约 35 款第三方视频模型整合，创作者可以为分镜、角色设计、音频和最终成片选择、组合不同模型。TCV 表示，它看中的是这套面向创作者、品牌营销人员与代理机构的 AI 内容制作流程。

英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳的活动上表示，Higgsfield 已从生成短片段发展到能生成更长、保持物理与时间一致性的视频，推理与智能体系统的进步使视频能够展开连贯叙事。
title_en: Nvidia and TCV Back AI Video Platform Higgsfield to Fuel Global Expansion
content_en:
AI video startup Higgsfield has secured fresh funding from Nvidia and venture capital firm TCV as an extension of its Series B round raised in August. The investment will be used to expand its global infrastructure and scale its engineering team.

Co-founded in 2023 by former Snap executive Alex Mashrabov and AI engineer Yerzat Dulat, the San Francisco-headquartered startup operates a significant portion of its engineering operations out of Kazakhstan and has amassed over 40 million registered users. Higgsfield's platform integrates its proprietary AI engine with around 35 third-party video models, enabling creators, marketers, and agencies to combine tools for storyboarding, character design, audio, and final rendering.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang praised the company's progress during an event in Astana, Kazakhstan, highlighting Higgsfield's evolution from generating short video clips to producing longer, highly coherent content supported by advanced reasoning and agentic systems.

title_zh: 君联资本据报参与 DeepSeek 融资，与联想集团同属联想控股
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》10 月 22 日援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 新一轮融资的投资者包括君联资本、专注半导体领域的石溪资本，以及吉利。君联资本与联想集团同属联想控股体系，分别承担投资平台和核心产业公司的角色。

报道还称，DeepSeek 已聘请中信证券为 IPO 提供顾问服务，并在 9 月招募一位前风险投资人担任首席财务官。公司正加快上市准备，目标是明年年初在上海上市。

联想已在 AI PC、服务器及企业 AI 解决方案中推进 DeepSeek 模型适配。此次参与融资的主体是君联资本，联想集团的既有产品适配与君联资本的投资是不同业务动作。
title_en: DeepSeek Secures Investment from Legend Capital Ahead of Targeted Shanghai IPO
content_en:
Chinese AI company DeepSeek has reportedly secured new investment from Legend Capital, semiconductor-focused Shixi Capital, and automaker Geely, according to sources cited by *The Wall Street Journal*. Legend Capital and technology giant Lenovo Group are both subsidiaries of Legend Holdings, operating as investment platform and core industrial enterprise, respectively.

DeepSeek is accelerating its listing plans, targeting an initial public offering (IPO) in Shanghai as early as early next year. The company has retained CITIC Securities as its IPO adviser and recruited a former venture capitalist as Chief Financial Officer in September.

While Lenovo has already been integrating DeepSeek's models into its AI PCs, servers, and enterprise AI solutions, Legend Capital's investment represents a separate financial commitment within the broader Legend Holdings ecosystem.

title_zh: 💡 杨元庆：未来 80% 的 Token 将在终端和边缘生成
content_zh:
联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆在近期一场内部领导力培训中表示，未来 80% 的 Token 将在终端和边缘侧生成。他把「端—边—云」协同列为联想发展 AI 计算的重要方向；这一比例是其对未来计算分布的预测。

杨元庆认为，AI 生态正从芯片和操作系统，转向计算、模型和数据。随着模型规模和 Token 用量增加，提升计算效率、降低使用成本将成为普及 AI 的关键。他提出发展 Token Hub，在统一算力平台上把不同工作负载分配给不同模型。

在终端形态上，他判断每个人都将需要一台家用服务器或属于自己的 AI 中心，设备也会逐渐成为智能体持续运行、协同工作的工具。联想正以「一体多端」推进个人 AI，并通过个人超级智能体 Qira 整合跨设备体验。

他还透露，联想内部每月消耗的 Token 已达一万亿个，并表示公司需要继续投资，为下一轮 AI 应用增长做准备。
title_en: Lenovo CEO Yang Yuanqing Predicts 80% of AI Tokens Will Be Generated on Edge and End-User Devices
content_en:
Lenovo Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing recently shared his vision for the future of AI computing during an internal leadership session, predicting that 80% of AI tokens will eventually be generated at the device and edge levels. He highlighted the synergy between "Device, Edge, and Cloud" as a core strategic focus for Lenovo's AI roadmap.

According to Yang, the AI ecosystem is shifting from chips and operating systems toward computing power, models, and data. As model sizes and token usage surge, improving computational efficiency and lowering costs will be essential for AI adoption. To address this, he proposed developing a "Token Hub" to allocate diverse workloads across different models on a unified computing platform.

Regarding device form factors, Yang foresees that every individual will eventually require a personal home server or AI hub, with hardware evolving into continuous execution tools for AI agents. Lenovo is advancing its personal AI vision through a "One Architecture, Multiple Devices" strategy, leveraging its personal super-agent, Qira, to deliver a seamless cross-device experience.

Yang also revealed that Lenovo internally consumes one trillion tokens every month, emphasizing the need for continued investment to prepare for the next wave of AI application growth.

title_zh: 华为 Pura90 Plus 开启预订，全系 12GB 内存、提供四款配色
content_zh:
华为终端宣布，Pura90 系列新增 Pura90 Plus，10 月 23 日 10:08 开启预订，并邀请用户进店体验。

官方海报列出的预订渠道包括华为商城、授权电商、华为体验店及授权零售商。海报同时展示了新机外观：机背采用紫金渐变配色，三颗后置摄像头排列在圆角三角形模组中，旁边保留 XMAGE 标识。

华为商城预订页面列出 12GB + 256GB、12GB + 512GB 和 12GB + 1TB 三种版本，全系配备 12GB 内存；配色包括曜石黑、雪域白、霞光紫和晨曦金。
title_en: Huawei Opens Pre-Orders for Pura 90 Plus Featuring Standard 12GB RAM and Four Colorways
content_en:
Huawei Terminal has officially announced that pre-orders for the new Pura 90 Plus will open on October 23 at 10:08 AM. Pre-order channels include the Huawei Mall, authorized e-commerce platforms, and physical retail stores.

Official teasers highlight a distinctive purple-and-gold gradient back panel with a triple rear-camera setup arranged in a rounded triangular module, retaining the signature XMAGE logo.

The Pura 90 Plus features 12GB of RAM as standard across all variants, offering three storage options: 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB. Buyers can choose from four colorways: Obsidian Black, Snow White, Sunset Purple, and Sunrise Gold.

title_zh: 飞书适配 iPhone Duo，支持分屏拖拽和大屏会议
content_zh:
飞书公布 iPhone Duo 适配介绍，重点展示了展开屏幕后的办公操作：通过分屏拖拽把资料发给同事，以及用更大的显示区域查看会议共享内容。

文档、表格和 PPT 的阅读界面也针对不同屏幕状态调整，支持小屏及横屏阅读。视频则可以分屏播放，让用户一边观看、一边在聊天中讨论内容。
title_en: Feishu Adapts for Dual-Screen Devices, Adding Split-Screen Drag-and-Drop and Expanded Meeting Views
content_en:
Feishu has announced new optimizations tailored for dual-screen setups, highlighting productivity enhancements when using unfolded screens. The updates enable users to share files with colleagues via split-screen drag-and-drop and view shared meeting content on a larger display area.

The reading interfaces for Documents, Spreadsheets, and Slides have also been optimized for different screen states, supporting both portrait and landscape views. Additionally, split-screen video playback is now supported, allowing users to watch videos while simultaneously participating in chat discussions.

title_zh: 钛动发布 Navos Pro，让 AI 主动监测广告并提出投放建议
content_zh:
钛动科技在广州举行的 TGC 2026 科技增长大会上发布 Navos Pro，面向跨境电商、外贸、营销和商业分析场景，将品牌知识库、广告监测及投放建议整合到智能体工作流中。

据公司介绍，用户输入品牌官网后，Navos Pro 可以解析品牌信息、建立私有知识库，并保留业务记忆。系统围绕账户、商品和素材持续监测，主动给出预算、出价、卖点及素材迭代建议，再由智能体或人工执行，业务决策权保留在人手中。

其技术架构包括 Agent Harness、32B／27B／5B 专业模型，以及营销知识库、指标库和样本数据；工具层接入 70 多个 MCP 和 100 多项 Skill，覆盖选品、素材创作、广告诊断等流程。Navos 设有 Lite 与 Pro 两个版本。

钛动同时宣布启动 Pro-Agent Global Challenge 全球挑战赛，征集智能体架构、AI 营销、内容入口和算力基础设施等领域的创业项目。
title_en: Tec-Do Launches Navos Pro: AI-Driven Ad Monitoring and Automated Strategy Recommendations
content_en:
Tec-Do Technology has officially launched Navos Pro at its TGC 2026 Technology Growth Conference in Guangzhou. Tailored for cross-border e-commerce, international trade, and marketing analytics, the platform integrates brand knowledge bases, ad monitoring, and strategic recommendations into automated AI agent workflows.

By processing a brand's website URL, Navos Pro extracts brand information to construct a private knowledge base with persistent business memory. The system continuously tracks advertising accounts, products, and creative assets to proactively generate recommendations on budgets, bidding strategies, key selling points, and creative iterations, while leaving final execution decisions in human hands.

Under the hood, Navos Pro utilizes an Agent Harness framework alongside 32B, 27B, and 5B parameter specialized models, integrating over 70 Model Context Protocols (MCPs) and 100 skill modules. Available in Lite and Pro editions, its release is accompanied by the Pro-Agent Global Challenge, an initiative scouting global startups in AI marketing, agent architecture, and computing infrastructure.

title_zh: 王腾回应 iFlow 温控系统价格对标 iPhone Duo
content_zh:
今日宜休创始人王腾回应 ISHO iFlow 智能温控系统的定价讨论时表示，团队会争取在产品优于竞品的基础上提供更高性价比，但温控系统属于全新品类，实现复杂，供应链还不成熟，「初始成本确实比较贵」。

此前，他在微博发起投票，询问用户是否愿意用一部 iPhone Duo 的预算换取睡眠升级，并介绍这套系统会根据身体状态动态感知、自动调节睡眠环境。这是预算选择与产品定位的讨论，尚不是 iFlow 正式售价的公布。
title_en: ISHO Founder Addresses iFlow Smart Climate System Pricing Concerns
content_en:
Wang Teng, founder of sleep technology brand ISHO, recently responded to public discussions regarding the pricing of the upcoming iFlow smart temperature control system. He explained that as a novel product category involving complex implementation and an immature supply chain, initial manufacturing costs are inherently high, though the team strives to deliver strong value relative to competitors.

Addressing a recent social media poll where he asked users if they would allocate an "iPhone Duo" level budget to upgrade their sleep quality, Wang clarified that the prompt was intended to gauge consumer budget expectations and product positioning rather than announce an official retail price. The iFlow system is designed to dynamically sense physiological states and automatically adjust the sleep environment.

title_zh: 适马发布 FP2：376g 全画幅机身，支持 6K 全开门拍摄
content_zh:
适马 10 月 23 日发布全画幅无反相机 FP2，延续初代 fp 的小型模块化设计，机身重量约 376g，含电池与存储卡约 460g，厚度约 41.8mm。

FP2 搭载 2450 万像素部分堆栈式 CMOS，采用相位与对比度混合自动对焦，新增鸟类识别；最高支持每秒 20 张连拍。机身增加可向上翻转 90 度、向下翻转 45 度的触控屏，并内置约 70GB 存储，另有 SD 卡槽。

视频方面，新机支持 6K 全开门记录、ProRes RAW 与徕卡 L-Log，通过机顶开关切换 STILL 和 CINE 模式。32bit 浮点录音需搭配另售热靴单元 HU-21 与指定松下音频配件使用。

FP2 采用 L 卡口，并提供外置电子取景器等扩展配件。适马日本官方商城将于 10 月 29 日开启预订，11 月 11 日发售。
title_en: Sigma Unveils FP2: Ultralight 376g Full-Frame Camera with 6K Open Gate Recording
content_en:
Sigma has announced the FP2 full-frame mirrorless camera, maintaining the compact, modular philosophy of the original FP series. The camera body weighs approximately 376g (460g with battery and memory card) and measures 41.8mm in thickness, offering extreme portability.

Equipped with a 24.5-megapixel partially stacked CMOS sensor, the FP2 features a hybrid phase/contrast autofocus system with new bird-detection capabilities, supporting continuous shooting at up to 20 fps. Ergonomics have been upgraded with a tilting touchscreen (90° up, 45° down), and the device incorporates 70GB of internal storage alongside a standard SD card slot.

On the video front, the FP2 supports 6K Open Gate recording, ProRes RAW, and Leica L-Log, featuring a dedicated top switch to seamlessly toggle between Still and Cine modes. Built on the L-Mount ecosystem, pre-orders open in Japan on October 29, with official sales beginning November 11.

title_zh: One Fun Thing｜把 355 件 Game Boy 藏品做成一盘百科卡带
content_zh:
把卡带插进 Game Boy 后，屏幕上出现的是一座关于这台掌机的文字博物馆。收藏者 Marcel Pflug 将自己整理的 355 件藏品和一部小型百科做进 ROM：用户可以按主题翻阅、跨目录搜索，还能给想找的藏品加书签，靠卡带电池保存记录。

每件藏品还有一个二维码，用手机扫描掌机屏幕，就能打开网站上的完整条目和照片。这些二维码事先在 PC 上生成并写入 ROM；为适应 Game Boy 的画面限制，Pflug 把每个码拆成 16 种重复图块。正文每屏约能放 8 行、每行约 30 个字符，最满的一页用了 255 个可用图块中的 251 个。

这盘百科卡带的 1.0 版已于今年 9 月公开。官方提供免费 ROM，可通过兼容烧录卡在真实 Game Boy 上运行，也能直接在浏览器里打开。
title_en: One Fun Thing: Collector Turns 355 Game Boy Items Into an Interactive Encyclopedia Cartridge
content_en:
Collector Marcel Pflug has built a text-based digital museum for the Game Boy, compiling 355 items from his collection along with a mini-encyclopedia into a single custom ROM. When inserted into a Game Boy, the cartridge lets users browse by topic, perform cross-directory searches, and save bookmarked items using the cartridge's built-in battery.

Each collection item includes a unique QR code displayed on the Game Boy screen, allowing users to scan it with a smartphone to view complete web entries and photos. To overcome the handheld's graphical limitations, Pflug generated the codes on a PC and split each into 16 reusable screen tiles. Each text screen displays roughly eight lines of up to 30 characters, with the most crowded page utilizing 251 out of 255 available display tiles.

Version 1.0 of the encyclopedia cartridge was released in September. The free ROM can be played on original Game Boy hardware using a compatible flash cart or run directly in a web browser.

title_zh: 周末看什么｜《流人》第六季，失意特工对抗机构内部的腐坏
content_zh:
《流人》里的斯劳屋，是英国军情五处安置失意特工的部门。Gary Oldman 饰演的 Jackson Lamb 脾气暴躁、言辞刻薄，带着一群因职业失误被打发到这里的人，在办案时不断撞上情报机构的权力斗争。这部黑色幽默间谍剧改编自 Mick Herron 的小说，第六季于 9 月 16 日在 Apple TV 开播，目前已播完。

《纽约客》评论人 Inkoo Kang 在季终剧评中认为，近两季让作品更有现实针对性：调查最初指向外国间谍或国内恐怖分子，最终却常常牵出为个人利益制造混乱的政府官僚。第六季围绕西敏寺权贵与俄罗斯资金展开，追杀、爆炸与办公室里的利益交换并行；她认为剧集保留了间谍惊悚的紧凑节奏，也继续书写这群人各自寻找救赎的过程。
title_en: Weekend Watch: 'Slow Horses' Season 6 Tackles Institutional Corruption and Broken Spies
content_en:
Adapted from Mick Herron's spy novels, *Slow Horses* centers on Slough House—the administrative dumping ground for MI5's disgraced operatives. Led by the foul-mouthed and cynical Jackson Lamb (played by Gary Oldman), this band of outcast agents repeatedly stumbles into high-level intelligence power struggles. The dark comedy espionage series premiered its sixth season on Apple TV+ on September 16 and has recently wrapped up its run.

In her season finale review for *The New Yorker*, critic Inkoo Kang noted that recent seasons have sharpened the show's real-world resonance. What begins as investigations into foreign spies or domestic terrorists often leads back to corrupt government bureaucrats sowing chaos for personal gain. Centering on Westminster power players and Russian funds, Season 6 balances explosive action and high-stakes chases with office backroom deals, retaining its tight spy-thriller pacing while exploring the characters' ongoing search for redemption.

title_zh: 买书不读指南｜《克拉拉与太阳》，从人工朋友的目光看人类的承诺
content_zh:
克拉拉是一位专为陪伴儿童而设计的太阳能「人工朋友」。在石黑一雄的小说《克拉拉与太阳》中，她坐在商店橱窗边，观察来往行人与前来挑选的孩子，等待有人把自己带走；当改变命运的机会出现时，她也被提醒，不要过分相信人类的承诺。

小说把叙述交给这位观察细致的机器人，让她从人的动作、话语与相互关系中理解人类。原版出版社将爱与承诺列为作品的核心问题；人工陪伴关系构成了故事的设定，人与人如何付出感情也进入克拉拉的观察。简体中文版由宋佥翻译，上海译文出版社于 2021 年 4 月出版。
title_en: Book Guide: Kazuo Ishiguro's 'Klara and the Sun' Examines Human Promises Through the Eyes of an AI Companion
content_en:
In Kazuo Ishiguro's novel *Klara and the Sun*, Klara is a solar-powered "Artificial Friend" designed to provide companionship for children. From her spot in a store window, she attentively observes passersby and prospective buyers, patiently waiting to be selected. Yet, when a life-changing opportunity arises, she is warned not to put too much faith in human promises.

By placing the narrative entirely in the hands of an exceptionally observant robot, the novel explores human behavior through subtle gestures, spoken words, and complex emotional ties. At its core, the story uses the premise of artificial companionship to examine deep-seated questions about love, commitment, and how human beings express affection.

title_zh: 游戏推荐｜《Dreadline Express》，用卡牌解开末日列车的乘客谜团
content_zh:
《Dreadline Express》把幸存者安置在末日里的一列火车上。玩家穿过车厢、与乘客交谈，把找到的卡牌收入卡册，再利用它们解锁道具、路径和人物故事。不同的组合与选择会改变探索方向，乘客也可能成为盟友或敌人。

捷克开发者 David Konecny 在 Deadline 访谈中说，这是一款玩家不会死亡的心理恐怖游戏。压力来自线索判断、牺牲谁以及如何处理乘客的命运；他为项目主导设计与开发，另有协作者负责美术和音频。游戏采用 PS1 风格的低分辨率画面，以棱角鲜明的人物和留有空白的场景呈现恐怖感。

游戏由 Shoreline Games 发行，10 月 16 日登陆 Steam，支持 Windows。截稿时 Steam 全部评测为「特别好评」，127 篇用户评测中有 97% 为好评。官方简体中文商店页仍沿用英文名，并注明页面中文介绍是临时机器翻译。
title_en: 'Dreadline Express': A Card-Driven Psychological Horror on a Post-Apocalyptic Train
content_en:
Set aboard a train carrying survivors through an apocalyptic wasteland, *Dreadline Express* combines narrative deck-building with immersive exploration. Players navigate train cars, converse with passengers, and collect cards to unlock new items, branching paths, and hidden character backstories. Strategic card combinations and dialogue choices dictate the story's direction, determining whether fellow passengers become allies or adversaries.

Created by Czech developer David Konecny, the title offers a unique psychological horror experience where player death is impossible. Instead, the tension stems from deciphering cryptic clues, making agonizing moral choices, and deciding who to sacrifice. The game embraces retro aesthetics with PS1-era low-poly graphics, utilizing sharp angular character models and desolate, minimalistic spaces to evoke a sense of dread.

Published by Shoreline Games, *Dreadline Express* launched on Steam for Windows on October 16, earning a "Very Positive" reception with a 97% positive user rating.
